Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing certain counties to assume the administrative duties of a county ferry district.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to county ferries; adding a new section to chapter36.54 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that: (a) County ferries provide a necessary public service to Washingtoncitizens and are an important part of the Washington statetransportation system. County ferries connect citizens to their jobs,schools, and communities. (b) County ferry districts are funded by local tax dollars, and thedistricts' governing bodies have a responsibility to their citizens towisely use these funds to maximize the benefit to their communities andto efficiently manage administrative costs. (c) Where county ferry districts and the county legislativeauthority are the same entity, savings can be found by allowing thecounty legislative authority to take on the administrative costsassociated with the county ferry district. (2) The purpose of this chapter is to allow a county in which aferry district has been established pursuant to RCW 36.54.110 through36.54.190 where the boundaries are coterminous with the boundaries of p. 1 SB 6216the county to assume the rights, powers, functions, and obligations ofthe county ferry district in order to achieve administrative savingsthat can be used to provide ferry service to its citizens.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.54 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Where administrative savings may be obtained, counties may assumethe responsibilities inherent in the operation of a county ferrydistrict if the county legislative authority is also the governing bodyof the county ferry district. The assumption of the administrativeduties of a county ferry district may be initiated by the adoption ofan ordinance or a resolution by the county legislative authorityindicating its intention to conduct a hearing concerning the assumptionof such duties.
